Q5171.reason: Blood products out of refrigeration should be started within about 30 minutes and completed within 4 hours, since bacterial growth and deterioration rise after that.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle is made up of diastole (relaxation and filling) and systole (contraction and ejection).

Q8473.reason: Hektoen enteric agar selects for Salmonella and Shigella, so a positive culture points to Salmonella, though C. difficile is the classic post-antibiotic cause.
